pythonFunction.name: verify_passcode
pythonFunction.description:
Validate a spoken passcode against the resolved account. Reads the caller's account records from the _caller_accounts session variable (populated by lookup_accounts_by_caller — call that first). Identify the target account by account_id for multi-location callers; single-account callers resolve implicitly. Comparison is case- and whitespace-insensitive.

Returns:
    dict: status, verified (bool), and on failure an agent_action hint.
